name: Restore — Starter
coachNote: Starter framework plan. The morning block is your established restore work; the gym rotation is a conservative placeholder to be replaced by your real programming session with Claude.

morning.title: Morning stretch
morning.note: Breathing first, always — it sets up everything after it.

exercises.name: 90/90 hip breathing
exercises.why: A flared ribcage keeps hip flexors and neck muscles on duty. Full exhales stack ribs over pelvis so everything after this works on the right tissue.
exercises.feel: Ribs melting down on the exhale, low back gently flattening, abs lightly on. Nothing in the neck.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
exercises.why: Squeeze the glute of the down leg — that tucks the pelvis and puts the stretch on the hip flexor instead of the low back.
exercises.feel: Front of the hip on the down leg. If it's in your low back, tuck the pelvis harder and shrink the lunge.

exercises.name: Doorway pec stretch
exercises.why: Tight pecs pull the shoulders forward and keep your back muscles from engaging. Opening the front is what lets the back turn on.
exercises.feel: Across the chest and front of the shoulder. Never pins-and-needles down the arm — back off if so.

exercises.name: Band pull-aparts
exercises.why: Feel it between the shoulder blades, not in the arms. If the neck kicks in, lighten the band.
exercises.feel: Squeeze between the shoulder blades at the end of each rep. Arms are just handles.

exercises.name: Frog pumps
exercises.why: Easiest glute drill to actually feel. If single-leg bridges keep going to your hamstring, these re-establish the pattern.
exercises.feel: Glutes squeezing at the top, soles of feet together. Hamstrings should stay quiet.

exercises.name: Seated neck side stretch
exercises.why: Hours at a screen load the upper traps. A slow side stretch interrupts the creep before it becomes the 4pm lock.
exercises.feel: A gentle line from ear to shoulder. Ease, never yank — the neck responds to slow.

exercises.name: Chair-back thoracic extension
exercises.why: Slumping lives in the mid-back. Draping over the chair back reverses the shape you've been holding all morning.
exercises.feel: Opening through the mid-back and chest, not pinching in the low back.

exercises.name: Doorway pec opener (coffee-run version)
exercises.why: Same front-line opener as the morning, disguised as leaning in a doorway on the way to the kitchen.
exercises.feel: Across the chest. Casual on the outside, purposeful on the inside.

gymDays.title: Full body A
gymDays.goalThread: Starter rotation · builds the squat + press patterns · placeholder until your real program lands

lifts.name: Goblet squat
lifts.why: the squat pattern, front-loaded so your trunk learns to stay tall
lifts.feel: Whole foot rooted, quads and glutes working, chest tall. Low back quiet.

lifts.name: Dumbbell bench press
lifts.why: horizontal press — chest and triceps without a barbell's commitment
lifts.feel: Chest doing the pushing, shoulder blades tucked back into the bench.

lifts.name: Seated cable row
lifts.why: the row pattern — mid-back strength that undoes the desk
lifts.feel: Shoulder blades squeezing together, elbows drawing back. Not a bicep exercise.

lifts.name: Plank
lifts.why: honest trunk time — stop at the first droop
lifts.feel: Abs and glutes sharing the load. The moment hips sag, the set is over.

gymDays.title: Full body B
gymDays.goalThread: Starter rotation · builds the hinge + pull patterns · placeholder until your real program lands

lifts.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
lifts.why: the hinge — hamstrings and glutes learning to carry load
lifts.feel: Hamstrings stretching on the way down, glutes finishing the stand. Back stays a quiet plank.

lifts.name: Lat pulldown
lifts.why: vertical pull — lats, the muscle your band pull-aparts have been prepping
lifts.feel: Elbows driving down into your back pockets. Lats, not forearms.

lifts.name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
lifts.why: vertical press — shoulders that carry groceries and confidence
lifts.feel: Delts pressing, ribs stacked. Don't let the low back arch to cheat.

lifts.name: Banded lateral walk
lifts.why: glute med — the pelvis stabilizer everything else stands on
lifts.feel: Side of the hip burning, torso quiet, constant band tension.

gymDays.title: Upper focus
gymDays.goalThread: Starter rotation · extra volume for back and shoulders · placeholder until your real program lands

lifts.name: Single-arm dumbbell row
lifts.why: unilateral row — each side earns its own strength
lifts.feel: Lat and mid-back drawing the elbow to your hip. No torso twist.

lifts.name: Incline dumbbell press
lifts.why: upper-chest press angle to round out the pushing pattern
lifts.feel: Upper chest and front delts. Shoulder blades stay tucked.

lifts.name: Face pulls
lifts.why: your posture work, loaded — rear delts and lower traps on duty
lifts.feel: Back of the shoulders and between the blades. Light weight, honest squeeze.

lifts.name: Wall slide with lift-off
lifts.why: that inch of lift-off is your lower traps doing the work they've been skipping
lifts.feel: Lower traps lifting the forearms off the wall. Upper traps and neck stay soft.

gymDays.title: Lower focus
gymDays.goalThread: Starter rotation · glutes and legs, the physique day · placeholder until your real program lands

lifts.name: Single-leg glute bridge (3-sec hold)
lifts.why: the hold is a recruitment test on every rep — felt in the glute, not the hamstring
lifts.feel: One glute doing all the work, pelvis level as a tabletop. Regress to frog pumps if it drifts.

lifts.name: Split squat
lifts.why: single-leg strength — where balanced, strong legs actually come from
lifts.feel: Front quad and glute. Torso tall, back knee kissing the floor.

lifts.name: Seated or lying leg curl
lifts.why: direct hamstring work so the RDL has partners
lifts.feel: Hamstrings only. Slow on the way back.

lifts.name: Standing calf raise
lifts.why: ankles that push back when you walk as much as you do
lifts.feel: Full stretch at the bottom, full squeeze at the top. Slow both ways.
